'''Dolomite''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Magma Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].  A [[Coral]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 1 Dolomite when the population of the pond reaches 9.

==Bundles==
Dolomite is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Dolomite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Dolomite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt113|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a pink dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the red dye pot at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]], for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
Dolomite is not used in any [[quests]].
